title.narrative: Stipend Support to Counterterrorism Officers in Somalia

description.narrative: The stipends support for the Somali Police Force Criminal Investigation Division project and Somali aviation authorities will support the growth and development of the personnel by disbursing monthly stipends to counterterrorism officers. The goal of the project is to ensure that designated counterterrorism units receive monthly stipends. UNOPS will provide oversight to ensure the funds are disbursed through a punctual and transparent e-payment process that is free of any corrupt or fraudulent practices. Lastly, UNOPS will ensure that the officers receiving stipends under this project are registered and verified and that they have undergone Somali basic police training and have received and are compliant with UN Human Rights Due Diligence Training. The overall project outcome will seek to support the establishment of a unified, capable, accountable and rights-based Somali federal security institution in order to provide basic safety and security for its citizens. \n
